title: Fix MSVC D8050 error in libsqlite3-sys compilation by disabling debug info in dev and release profiles
diff_summary: 1. src-tauri/Cargo.toml: Added [profile.dev.package.libsqlite3-sys] debug = false and [profile.release.package.libsqlite3-sys] debug = false. This disables passing the -Z7 debug flag to MSVC cl.exe when building sqlite3.c with its massive list of -DSQLITE_ defines, completely eliminating error D8050 ('cannot execute c1.dll: failed to put command line into debug record'). 2. src-tauri/.cargo/config.toml: Deleted obsolete file containing ineffective CRATE_CC_NO_DEFAULTS = '1'.
notes: Verified compilation of libsqlite3-sys and the whole backend in isolated worktree with MSVC toolchain; full cargo check and clippy run clean with zero warnings; React frontend builds cleanly.
